settings.heading: The Reason Your Bloating Keeps Coming Back
settings.heading_highlight: Is Not What You Were Told
settings.body:
Bad bacteria don't just sit in your gut.

Over time they hide under a slimy layer called biofilm. Think of it as a shield.

That's why the usual fixes don't last:

  • Diets starve the bacteria. They don't remove them.
  • Probiotics add more bacteria on top.
  • Antibiotics and single herbs only hit what's out in the open.

The ones under the shield survive. Then they grow back. And so does your bloating.

settings.heading: Break the shield. Clear what's behind it.
settings.body:
Nothing you tried was wrong. It just never got past the shield.

Garlic helps open the shield. That lets oregano, wormwood and black walnut reach what was hiding behind it.*

7 herbs working together, in every dropper.

settings.question: Who should not take these drops?
settings.answer:
Talk to your doctor first if you:

  • are pregnant, nursing or trying to get pregnant
  • are under 18
  • take blood thinners or any prescription medicine
  • have seizures, or a liver, kidney or gallbladder condition
  • are allergic to ragweed or daisies (wormwood is in that plant family)

settings.question: How do I take it?
settings.answer:
Shake well.

Start with a few drops in a little water or juice, once a day.

Work up to one full dropper a day. Or follow the label.

settings.question: Will I feel anything when I start?
settings.answer:
Some people notice changes in gas or digestion in the first few days. That's why we suggest starting small.

If anything feels wrong, stop and talk to your doctor.

settings.question: When should I see a doctor instead?
settings.answer:
See a doctor if your bloating comes with:

  • weight loss
  • blood in your stool
  • vomiting
  • fever or bad pain

These drops are for everyday gut support.*
